section_5_verbatim:
The four fix groups Codex completed over the past few days must actually become visible to the user in the live dev runtime. The user's verdict — "彻底没有实现需求" — must be invalidated by closing the source ↔ runtime ↔ live-UI loop for each of the four requirements:

1. **MCP elicitation** — Codex calling Playwright MCP must no longer report `user rejected MCP tool call`, and must no longer log `Unknown server request: mcpServer/elicitation/request`. Verified by triggering a real Playwright MCP call from a Codex session in dev UI.
2. **Codex tool rendering** — In Happy UI (dev), Codex tool cards on the main transcript must show `command`, `stdout`, `stderr`, `result`, and `status` / `exit code` for the tools that have specialized renderers (Bash, Subagent, Parallel, Patch, Diff, Attachment, Plan). Detail and sidebar views must show the same information without `[object Object]` and without duplication. Behavior must align with how Claude Code renders these on the same screens.
3. **Codex attachments** — When the user attaches an image (and a non-image file) to a Codex session, the model's reply must demonstrate that it received the content (not just a path). At minimum: image attachments must reach the model as `localImage` input items; non-image file behavior must be either fully implemented or explicitly out of scope (decision documented).
4. **Generic tool scope-leak** — Generic Claude tools without specialized renderers (Grep, Glob, WebSearch, ToolSearch) must NOT show input/output on the main transcript. At the same time, Codex generic / unknown / resource tools must NOT be hidden as collateral damage — they should still render their result inline as the fixture file expects.

Each of the four must be verified live, on both desktop (≥1280×720) and mobile (390×844) viewports of `https://dev.life-ai.app` or `http://localhost:8097`. Code review, grep, curl, or fixture-only test pass is **not** sufficient evidence — every requirement needs a live screenshot pair as evidence. Per CLAUDE.md, production URLs and ports are off-limits.
user_acceptance_summary: Four fix groups (D1 MCP elicitation, D2 Codex tool rendering, D3 Codex attachments, D4 Generic tool scope-leak) must each be live-verified on both desktop (≥1280×720) and mobile (390×844) viewports of dev.life-ai.app or localhost:8097, with screenshot evidence. Fixture-only / source-only / curl evidence is not sufficient. Production targets are off-limits.

See assumptions[3].

assumptions: [ASSUMPTION-1] D1 'every Playwright MCP elicitation form' is interpreted as 'every Playwright MCP elicitation shape that arrives in the cycle's live Codex session', not 'every theoretically possible MCP elicitation shape across the protocol surface'. Rationale: Codex consult flagged this as untestable otherwise. QA must capture each observed shape in /root/.happy-dev/logs/ and confirm handler accepts each.

[ASSUMPTION-2] D2 evidence is per-tool × per-view (Bash/Subagent/Parallel/Patch/Diff/Attachment/Plan × main-transcript/detail/sidebar = up to 21 cells × desktop+mobile = up to 42 captures). A single screenshot pair is INSUFFICIENT. QA must produce a per-cell screenshot or DOM-text capture matrix, with explicit zero-count check for '[object Object]' and no-duplication check per cell.

[ASSUMPTION-3] D3 non-image decision must produce three artifacts before QA grants D3 pass: (a) Section 3 of monolith documents which path (a-implement OR b-images-only) was chosen; (b) if path-b chosen, UI surfaces the limitation visibly (greyed-out attach button OR warning toast OR equivalent affordance); (c) user has explicitly confirmed the down-scoping in writing in this cycle's awaiting-user reply. Dev/QA may NOT self-declare non-image out of scope.

[ASSUMPTION-4] D4 evidence has TWO mandatory halves: (a) NEGATIVE — Claude Code Grep/Glob/WebSearch/ToolSearch cards remain collapsed on main transcript (regression guard for the 2026-04-25 scope-leak incident); (b) POSITIVE — Codex generic/unknown/resource tools render inline on main transcript per fixture expectations. Spec Section 5 D4 explicitly demands both halves. S7 D4 acceptance bullet as written only checks (a); BA explicitly extends acceptance to require (b) live evidence on desktop AND mobile.

[ASSUMPTION-5] The 'same session must include Claude Code Bash and Grep' phrase in S7 D2 is interpreted as 'same QA verification run / companion Claude Code session' since Codex and Claude Code may be separate session flavors in dev UI. Codex consult flagged this. BA records the relaxation; QA may run two parallel sessions (one Codex, one Claude Code) within the same QA cycle to satisfy both the equivalence checklist AND the no-leak regression guard.

codex_consultation.query_verbatim_summary: USER REQUIREMENT: Confirm that the BA-level coverage table for spec-20260502-162334 (Codex 4-fix runtime closure) maps each of D1..D4 onto S-steps that will produce live-runtime evidence and invalidate the user verdict that prior attempts did not deliver anything visible. SCOPE: find bugs that prevent or threaten this requirement. CHALLENGE QUESTIONS: (1) D1..D4 covered or gap? (2) S7 desktop+mobile sufficient? Measurable signal per D? (3) Anything vague enough QA could PASS partial? (4) Contract D L4 vs L3 novelty? (5) D3 non-image decision actionable? (6) Reasons BA confirmation would not pass downstream debate?
codex_consultation.feedback_summary: Overall coverage is directionally correct but should not close without tightening BA/QA contract gaps. Specific findings: (a) D1 — adequately mapped, but tighten 'every Playwright MCP elicitation form' to 'every observed shape in this cycle' otherwise QA can't prove. (b) D2 — 4×2 screenshots under-specified; need per-tool × per-view checklist; 'same session must include Claude Code Bash/Grep' likely impossible since Codex and Claude are separate session flavors — change wording to 'same QA run / companion Claude Code session'. (c) D3 — needs explicit decision checkpoint: Section 3 documentation + user-visible UI limitation + explicit user confirmation; Dev/QA must NOT self-declare out of scope. (d) D4 — concrete S7 GAP: Section 5 requires both halves (Claude no-leak + Codex inline render) but S7 D4 bullet only checks Claude collapsed; add explicit live evidence for Codex unknown/resource inline rendering or QA could pass partial evidence. (e) Runtime-evidence sufficiency: S7 invalidates user verdict only if each D has a measurable live signal (D1: live MCP result + negative log check; D2: all renderers all views, no [object Object], no duplication; D3: model references image content + non-image matches S6 decision visibly; D4: Claude no-leak AND Codex inline positive proof). (f) L4 novelty is REAL: S1/S-BUILD/S3/S4/S7 close source→dist/image→daemon/web runtime→live UI, which differs from prior L3 fixture-only failures; keep fixture tests as regression guards only, not acceptance evidence. (g) Likely close-blockers if unchanged: D4 positive Codex-inline omission, D2 evidence granularity, 'same session' Claude/Codex wording, and S6 decision timing.
